jobs.description: International, centrally positioned role with direct impact on the deployment of thousands of tank containers worldwide.You have a good job. Your work ensures that stakeholders across the globe can generate accurate, real-time reports at any moment and use them for decision-making.This level of tangible impact is rare in a data analyst role.About the organizationOur client is one of the largest tank container leasing companies in the world. With a global fleet and international customer base, data plays an increasingly critical role in its success.The organization is undergoing a transition from manual, Excel-driven processes to data-driven operations with real-time insights.As part of the Marmon Group (a Berkshire Hathaway company), you benefit from a strong international foundation combined with the dynamics of an evolving organization.The culture is open, international, and results-driven, offering significant responsibility and room for initiative.Your challengeAs a Data Analyst, you operate at the heart of an international operation. You have worked in a global supply chain environment (e.g. logistics, leasing, shipping, or manufacturing) and have proven experience with SIOP processes.You are not a pure IT specialist, but a business-oriented data analyst who understands how processes work and how data drives decision-making.Additionally:Fluent in English (Dutch is a plus)Available for a full-time role (40 hours)Comfortable working across multiple time zonesTechnical qualificationsIn this role, you operate at the intersection of data and supply chain.
